Does Brad Pitt die in Bullet Train?

He plays Ladybug.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows only the answer. Everything else stays behind its own curtain.

No.

He is alive when the credits roll.

How it happens, in words. No pictures yet.

Everyone else dies; his bad luck keeps him alive.

Anxious assassin Ladybug boards a Tokyo-to-Kyoto bullet train to grab a briefcase and instead gets tangled with Lemon, Tangerine, the Prince, the Hornet, and eventually the White Death. In the derailed wreckage the White Death shoots Ladybug with Ladybug's own gun, which the Prince had rigged to backfire, blowing off the villain's head. Ladybug limps out of the ruins into Maria's (Sandra Bullock) car, alive and complaining.

Nearly everyone else on the train dies.
